quest.title: Witch's Revelation: Voyaging Instruction
quest.description: You encounter Beidou at Barbeloth's fortune-telling booth...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Guide to Gold x3

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So, what you're saying is that this card I drew is actually pretty good?

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Haha, fate is simply fate. It makes no distinction between bad and good.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: However, talking solely about the upright Strength card you drew, one of its interpretations actually fits your profession well.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: This card symbolizes passion, courage, confidence, and desire, as well as perfect, unfaltering love.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: No matter what surprises fate throws your way, I believe you will take control and steer a steady course.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Don't flatter me! By our rules, a good fortune means paying extra for the reading.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Here, I'll leave my coin pouch with you. If you have the time, could you read the fortunes of my crew?

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Haha, that's the first time I've received a request like this.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We've sailed this ship from one corner of Teyvat to the other, braving the winds and waves. After so many years at sea, there isn't one among them who doesn't harbor troubles of their own.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I may be their captain, but there are things even I can't help them with.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So running into a fortune-teller like you, it made me think you might be able to help set their minds at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: As for recompense, that won't be a problem. We've done good business on our way here, and dragged in quite the haul...

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: As intriguing an offer as that is, I'm afraid I'll have to pass. I fear there aren't enough cards in my deck for such a sizable crew.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, Paimon? I haven't seen you in a long time! Are you here to have your fortunes read, too?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm here on business, of course. And to help a certain someone scout out new trade opportunities while I'm at it.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Our esteemed Tianquan, of course.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Who knows what kind of scheme she's cooked up this time? A few days ago — completely out of the blue — she tells me there's good business to be had in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Doesn't ask my opinion, just whips out a detailed itinerary and tells me to follow the trade route it outlines. Turns out she'd already sent people to scout ahead.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I haven't had any urgent business lately, so I went along with the whole thing. And what would you know, it's been plain sailing the whole way.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: What was supposed to be a two-week job got wrapped up in just over one...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I figured since we're already here, we might as well stick around and have some fun. So I gave the crew some shore leave to kick back and relax.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Matter of fact, just yesterday I booked an event space at the Hotel Debord, and the lot of us drank up a storm!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: The crew's still sleeping it off at the hotel, so I thought I'd venture out for some fresh air and to sober up.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: But I only made it a few steps before this... uhm, fortune-teller stopped me and asked me to draw a card...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, you've already drawn one?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Here, it's the Strength card... Looks like a good one, and since it's the right side up, I think that makes it even better?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Upright Strength... How should Paimon put this... It really does suit you, Beidou.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: It certainly does. Now, let me explain the other meaning it holds...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Don't tell me... It's bad news?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: I wouldn't say it's good or bad, and... hehe, it's not directly related to your fortune either. Just a little "after-class musing" now that your reading is over.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: It's clear that you possess both powerful outer strength and an indomitable inner spirit.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: To borrow a metaphor, you're a lantern in the dark night. You dispel the darkness and guide lost souls on their forward paths.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: But you must know that it's not only the lost and weak who are attracted to the glow. Bugs cling to the lantern, competing for light and heat.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Believing that it can keep them warm, the light burns more intensely. Only by doing so will its radiance not dim.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Now, it would be best if someone could drive these bugs away...

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Because if no one does, perhaps one day the flame will consume its remaining fuel, all for the sake of a few unworthy pests.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: ...If that's your concern, I don't think there's any need to worry.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I have a friend who knows how to help people figure things out, and... Well, hahaha, she enjoys taking care of pests who hide in the corners.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: A rare friend to have. Judging by your tone, you must really trust her. She doesn't sound like someone who would easily lose her way.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Her? Hahaha! If she were the type to get lost, I doubt anyone in Liyue would know how to stay on course.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Take this trip, for instance. She's the one who pointed the way...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Hah, it all makes sense now! I was just thinking, if she really wanted to do business, there's no way she'd let me kick back and relax.

choices.text: I suppose this is what you should expect from the Tianquan?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe... So basically, Ningguang just wanted to give you a holiday! But why make you take such a massive detour?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm sure she'd say something like "Some detours are needed. Only by taking them can the shortcuts be found."

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'll never be able to unravel the twists and turns of her mind. Hah... She still needs me to help expand her trade routes though, so it's not like she'd do me harm.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: As her "Strength" card, I'll remain up front, breaking the waves and forging a path ahead.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: ...Whoa! Look at the time. I'd better head back and check on my crew. See if I can't sober 'em up a little — get them shipshape and ready to sail.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Lady Fortune Teller, I hope to see you around!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: ...This card is a rare treasure... Can I keep it? Probably not... right? Hmm... I'll just take one last look...

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: A light that guides the lost... and those who come for more than its glow.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Interesting. If I have the time, I should pay another visit to Liyue...

choices.text: Even giving someone time off requires an elaborate ruse...
